_note: DeadDraw concept registry (ui-pass-3): every idea a new player meets, explained once, the first time it is on screen where it matters (main.gd concept_candidates() decides that; 'trigger' says it in words). Text: 1-2 plain sentences. Placeholders: {n:key} = balance number, {pts:key} = balance points as shown, {run_where} = where Run sends the cards. 'icon' = a Guide icon id (scripts/ui/dd_codex.gd icon()). Groups are the Guide's sections, in this order.

concepts.title: Hold to read
concepts.text: Press and hold anything (right click with a mouse) to see what it is and what it does for you.
concepts.trigger: Title screen: on the survivor cards.

concepts.title: Districts
concepts.text: The city has 3 districts. Each one is 3 waves of zombies, then a boss; beat the boss to move on.
concepts.trigger: Map: on the district you are about to enter.

concepts.title: The street
concepts.text: These {n:street_size} cards are the street. Deal with {n:actions} of them (the dots count them); the last one stays for the next street.
concepts.trigger: First street: on the street cards.

concepts.title: Pick a weapon, then a zombie
concepts.text: Tap a gun or your melee to hold it (it lights up). Then tap a zombie to attack it with that weapon.
concepts.trigger: First street: on the weapon you hold.

concepts.title: Zombies
concepts.text: The round red number is a zombie's strength: how hard it hits back. Kill it with a gun and it pays points.
concepts.trigger: First street: on a zombie.

concepts.title: Damage
concepts.text: The red chip on a zombie is the HP you lose if you attack it now: its strength minus your weapon's. 0 means no damage.
concepts.trigger: First street: on a zombie that would hurt you.

concepts.title: HP
concepts.text: Your health: if it reaches 0, the run ends. Medkits heal you, and Cover takes hits first.
concepts.trigger: The first time you lose HP: on the HP bar.

concepts.title: Points
concepts.text: Gun kills pay points to spend on rooms and machines in this district. Melee kills pay nothing.
concepts.trigger: After your first gun kill: on the points.

concepts.title: Capacity
concepts.text: The stack of squares on a gun is how many kills it holds before it pays out.
concepts.trigger: The first gun card on the street: on it.

concepts.title: Kill slots
concepts.text: Each gun kill fills one slot beside the gun. The top box says what the next kill needs: ≤5 means 5 or lower.
concepts.trigger: After your first gun kill: on that gun.

concepts.title: Fill a gun, get paid
concepts.text: Fill a gun's last slot for +{pts:finish_bonus} points, plus its challenge reward if you met it. Then the gun leaves; equip another.
concepts.trigger: A gun with one kill to go: on that gun.

concepts.title: Challenges
concepts.text: Each gun has a bonus goal (the medal line). Keep it until the gun is full to earn the extra reward.
concepts.trigger: After a gun's first kill: on its challenge line.

concepts.title: Encore
concepts.text: An ENCORE reward keeps the gun when it is full: it stays and starts over with empty slots.
concepts.trigger: A gun whose challenge pays Encore: on that gun.

concepts.title: Melee
concepts.text: Your melee takes any zombie, with no rule. It is weak and pays no points, but it is always there.
concepts.trigger: When the gun you hold can't take a zombie, or on the third street: on the melee button.

concepts.title: Melee weapons
concepts.text: A wrench or an axe hits harder than bare hands. Tap it to pick it up; it breaks after its uses.
concepts.trigger: The first melee weapon card on the street: on it.

concepts.title: Uses
concepts.text: The stack of dots on a melee weapon is its uses: each kill uses 1, and at 0 it breaks.
concepts.trigger: Shown with Melee weapons (Guide only).

concepts.title: Gun rules
concepts.text: Each gun only takes certain zombies; its rule is under its name. Zombies it can take are lit, the others say LOCK.
concepts.trigger: Shown with the first gun rule that limits you (Guide and inspect).

concepts.title: Any zombie (Service Pistol)
concepts.text: This gun takes any zombie, in any order.
concepts.trigger: The first time you hold a gun with this rule: on that gun.

concepts.title: Lower than last (Hunting Rifle)
concepts.text: Each kill must be lower than this gun's last kill, like 8, then 5, then 2. The first kill can be anything.
concepts.trigger: The first time you hold a gun with this rule: on that gun.

concepts.title: Higher than last (Ratchet Crossbow)
concepts.text: Each kill must be higher than this gun's last kill, like 2, then 5, then 9. The first kill can be anything.
concepts.trigger: The first time you hold a gun with this rule: on that gun.

concepts.title: Same as first (Twin-Bore)
concepts.text: Every kill must be the same number as this gun's first kill, like 4, 4, 4.
concepts.trigger: The first time you hold a gun with this rule: on that gun.

concepts.title: Zig-zag (Lever Rifle)
concepts.text: Kills go up, then down, then up again, never equal, like 3, 8, 2, 6. The first kill can be anything.
concepts.trigger: The first time you hold a gun with this rule: on that gun.

concepts.title: Within 1 (Scout Carbine)
concepts.text: Each kill is at most 1 away from the last one, like 5, 6, 5, 4. The first kill can be anything.
concepts.trigger: The first time you hold a gun with this rule: on that gun.

concepts.title: Odd / even (Nail Driver)
concepts.text: Kills switch between odd and even numbers, like 3, 8, 5, 10. The first kill can be anything.
concepts.trigger: The first time you hold a gun with this rule: on that gun.

concepts.title: Total ≤{n:spread_cap} (Pump Shotgun)
concepts.text: Any zombie, as long as all its kills add up to {n:spread_cap} or less. Reaching {n:spread_cap} fills it too.
concepts.trigger: The first time you hold a gun with this rule: on that gun.

concepts.title: Big only (Elephant Gun)
concepts.text: This gun only kills zombies of strength {n:big_min} or more.
concepts.trigger: The first time you hold a gun with this rule: on that gun.

concepts.title: Small only (Alley Sweeper)
concepts.text: This gun only kills zombies of strength {n:small_max} or less.
concepts.trigger: The first time you hold a gun with this rule: on that gun.

concepts.title: One shot (Stovepipe Launcher)
concepts.text: One kill fills this gun at once, so it pays out right away.
concepts.trigger: The first time you hold a gun with this rule: on that gun.

concepts.title: Locked zombies
concepts.text: LOCK means the gun you hold can't take that zombie now; the card says what it needs. Switch weapons or use melee.
concepts.trigger: The first zombie that shows LOCK: on it.

concepts.title: Bent rule
concepts.text: With the Loose Grip Patch, once per wave one gun kill may break its rule.
concepts.trigger: Guide only (the Patch explains it when you take it).

concepts.title: Medkits
concepts.text: Tap a medkit to heal the HP on its badge. It can't heal you past your max HP.
concepts.trigger: The first medkit on the street: on it.

concepts.title: Cover
concepts.text: Cover takes damage before your HP does. Tap a cover card to add its number to your Cover.
concepts.trigger: The first cover card on the street: on it.

concepts.title: Gun cards
concepts.text: A new gun: tap it to put it in a gun slot, or scrap it for points. The yellow number is how hard it hits.
concepts.trigger: The first gun card on the street: on it.

concepts.title: Salvage
concepts.text: Swapping out a gun that has kills pays part of them back as points.
concepts.trigger: Equipping a gun over one that has kills: on the choice.

concepts.title: Holdover
concepts.text: The card you didn't deal with stays and joins the next street.
concepts.trigger: The first holdover card: on it.

concepts.title: Draw pile
concepts.text: New street cards come off this pile. When it runs out, the next wave is shuffled in.
concepts.trigger: From the second street: on the pile.

concepts.title: Waves
concepts.text: The big number is the wave you are on. After the last wave comes the boss.
concepts.trigger: From the second street: on the wave door.

concepts.title: Run
concepts.text: Bad street? RUN costs {n:run_damage} HP: the street's cards {run_where} and you get new ones. Not twice in a row.
concepts.trigger: From the second street, when you can run: on RUN.

concepts.title: Your Cover
concepts.text: This is your Cover. Damage takes it away before it touches your HP.
concepts.trigger: The first time you have Cover: on it.

concepts.title: Rooms
concepts.text: Each door is a room. Pay its price in points to open it: 3 cards join the pile and its machine is yours to use.
concepts.trigger: Once you have points: on the first room.

concepts.title: Open a room
concepts.text: You can pay for this room now: tap its gold plate to open it.
concepts.trigger: The first room you can afford: on its gold plate.

concepts.title: Machines
concepts.text: An open room has a machine. Tap USE to use it, once per wave; each use costs points.
concepts.trigger: The first open room: on it.

concepts.title: Wall Rack
concepts.text: Buy the gun on the wall into one of your two gun slots.
concepts.trigger: The first Wall Rack you use: on it.

concepts.title: Retrofit Bench
concepts.text: Work on a gun you hold: TRIM takes off its last kill, FLIP turns lower into higher (or back), HONE makes it hit harder.
concepts.trigger: The first Retrofit Bench you use: on it.

concepts.title: Patch Press
concepts.text: Pay to see {n:patch_offer} Patches and keep one for the rest of the run.
concepts.trigger: The first Patch Press you use: on it.

concepts.title: Patches
concepts.text: A Patch is a bonus that lasts the whole run. Hold its icon to read what it does.
concepts.trigger: Your first Patch choice, or your first Patch: on it.

concepts.title: The boss street
concepts.text: No skipping here: deal with every card. Beat the boss to clear the district.
concepts.trigger: The first boss street: on the boss.

concepts.title: Shatter
concepts.text: The gun that kills this boss breaks. A melee kill is safe.
concepts.trigger: A boss with Shatter: on it.

concepts.title: Horde
concepts.text: This boss is a pack: several zombies arrive at once.
concepts.trigger: A Horde boss: on it.

concepts.title: Phases
concepts.text: This boss gets back up stronger after each kill, and there is no escape.
concepts.trigger: A boss with Phases: on it.

concepts.title: Run past
concepts.text: Before your first card on a boss street you may run past it: lose {n:boss_runpast_damage} HP, skip the boss, no reward.
concepts.trigger: The first boss street where you can run past: on RUN PAST.

concepts.title: Safehouse
concepts.text: A safe stop after each boss. Spend your points here: they stay behind when you leave.
concepts.trigger: The first safehouse: on its title.

concepts.title: Score
concepts.text: Your score counts every point you earned this run, even the ones you spent.
concepts.trigger: The first safehouse or run end: on the points.

concepts.title: Boss reward
concepts.text: Beating a boss gives you one Patch for free: tap the one you want.
concepts.trigger: The first boss reward: on the Patch choice.

concepts.title: Gun Mods
concepts.text: A Gun Mod goes on gun slot 1 or 2. Every gun you put in that slot gets it for the rest of the run.
concepts.trigger: The first Gun Mod offer or fitted mod: on it.

concepts.title: Open Breech
concepts.text: Gun Mod: the first 2 kills of the gun in this slot ignore its rule.
concepts.trigger: A gun slot with this mod: on that gun.

concepts.title: Last Round
concepts.text: Gun Mod: the kill that fills the gun in this slot ignores its rule.
concepts.trigger: A gun slot with this mod: on that gun.

concepts.title: Echo Chamber
concepts.text: Gun Mod: a zombie equal to the gun's last kill always fits.
concepts.trigger: A gun slot with this mod: on that gun.

concepts.title: Short Barrel
concepts.text: Gun Mod: the gun in this slot holds 1 fewer kill, so it fills sooner.
concepts.trigger: A gun slot with this mod: on that gun.

concepts.title: Steady Hands (Rosa)
concepts.text: Rosa's skill: her Hunting Rifle and Ratchet Crossbow also take a zombie equal to the last kill.
concepts.trigger: Map, playing Rosa: on her tile.

concepts.title: Triage (Imani)
concepts.text: Imani's skill: every medkit heals her {n:triage_bonus} more.
concepts.trigger: Map, playing Imani: on her tile.

concepts.title: Slip Away (Theo)
concepts.text: Theo's skill: running away costs him no HP.
concepts.trigger: Map, playing Theo: on his tile.
